title: Real empirical Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be finite, and let $m\in\mathbb N$. For a batch $x_0,\ldots,x_{m-1}$ of cube inputs, the real empirical Fourier coefficient on $S$ is $\frac{1}{m}\sum_{j=0}^{m-1} f(x_j)\prod_{i\in S}(x_j)_i$.
hypotheses_covered: The sample inputs form a function from the $m$ sample indices to the Boolean cube
